hero.description: Transform YouTube lectures, textbooks, and complex topics into adaptive quizzes, master weak subjects with NOVA Intelligence, and challenge students worldwide in real-time battles.

pillars.title: From Passive Video Watching to Verified Knowledge Mastery
pillars.subtitle: SYNAPSE replaces superficial memorization with an active feedback loop engineered to accelerate learning retention.
pillars.p1_desc: Ingest educational YouTube lectures, textbooks, or custom subjects with zero manual transcription.
pillars.p2_desc: Solve adaptive, curriculum-aligned multiple-choice questions with intelligent step-by-step hints.
pillars.p3_desc: NOVA evaluates your response times, precision, and concept mastery down to specific sub-topics.
pillars.p4_desc: Target weak points directly with auto-generated refreshers before knowledge gaps compound.
pillars.p5_desc: Battle friends and classmates in live, synchronized multiplayer quiz showdowns with Elo ratings.

battle_preview.title: Test Your Knowledge Under Pressure with Live Battles
battle_preview.desc: Create a private room code or challenge classmates to 10-question synchronized quiz battles. Earn rating points (Elo) and review post-match intelligence generated by NOVA.
battle_preview.feat1_desc: Both competitors answer the same questions with synchronized timers.
battle_preview.feat2_desc: Correct answers earn points with exponential multipliers for fast answers.
battle_preview.feat3_desc: Deep analysis identifying where each player excelled and which sub-topics need work.
battle_preview.nova_analysis: NOVA Battle Analysis: Alex achieved higher accuracy (+10%), while Sam answered questions 28% faster. Both players struggled with sign changes in quadratic roots.

analytics_preview.title: Actionable Insights, Not Vanity Statistics
analytics_preview.subtitle: SYNAPSE tracks retention decay, response speed, and difficulty factors to pinpoint exact learning gaps.
analytics_preview.nova_strategy: NOVA Strategy: Resolving these 3 weak topics will increase your estimated SAT Math readiness by +70 points.
